alternatives_rejected.why: Inbound caller-observed self-time rose only 1.11x while caller-side errors jumped 0.0->0.51 and own spans show no errors. That pattern means requests are dropped on the wire, not slowed (E2). The latency-50/90 blow-up in E1/E3 fits retries and timeouts after lost packets.
Traces show no significant change: own self-time 1.0x, inbound error rise only 0.0138 (E4).
Frontend error spikes (E1) line up with the ~51% failed calls into recommendationservice (E2), so they are propagated symptoms.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove the injected network impairment (e.g., tc netem loss rule) on the recommendationservice pod or its network interface. Verify that caller error rate and socket metrics return to baseline. If the cause is not an injected rule, check the pod's network/CNI and reschedule the pod onto a healthy node.
